mapper.select: SELECT vid, play_times, like_times, unlike_times, comment_times, coin_times, share_times, collect_times, danmu_times FROM video_status WHERE vid = #{vid}
mapper.update: UPDATE video_status SET play_times = CAST(play_times AS DECIMAL(20,0)) + 1 WHERE vid = #{vid} AND CAST(play_times AS DECIMAL(20,0)) < 9223372036854775807

UPDATE video_status
like_times = CAST(like_times AS DECIMAL(20,0)) + 1 unlike_times = CAST(unlike_times AS DECIMAL(20,0)) + 1
WHERE vid = #{vid}
AND CAST(like_times AS DECIMAL(20,0)) < 9223372036854775807
AND CAST(unlike_times AS DECIMAL(20,0)) < 9223372036854775807

UPDATE video_status
like_times = CAST(like_times AS DECIMAL(20,0)) - 1 unlike_times = CAST(unlike_times AS DECIMAL(20,0)) - 1
WHERE vid = #{vid}
AND CAST(like_times AS DECIMAL(20,0)) >= 1
AND CAST(unlike_times AS DECIMAL(20,0)) >= 1

UPDATE video_status SET coin_times = CAST(coin_times AS DECIMAL(20,0)) + CAST(#{coin} AS DECIMAL(20,0)) WHERE vid = #{vid} AND CAST(coin_times AS DECIMAL(20,0)) + CAST(#{coin} AS DECIMAL(20,0)) BETWEEN 0 AND 9223372036854775807
UPDATE video_status SET collect_times = CAST(collect_times AS DECIMAL(20,0)) + 1 WHERE vid = #{vid} AND CAST(collect_times AS DECIMAL(20,0)) < 9223372036854775807
UPDATE video_status SET collect_times = CAST(collect_times AS DECIMAL(20,0)) - 1 WHERE vid = #{vid} AND CAST(collect_times AS DECIMAL(20,0)) >= 1
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(vs.like_times), 0) FROM video_status vs INNER JOIN video v ON v.vid = vs.vid WHERE v.uid = #{uid} AND v.status = 1 AND v.visibility = 0 AND v.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE video_status SET share_times = CAST(share_times AS DECIMAL(20,0)) + 1 WHERE vid = #{vid} AND CAST(share_times AS DECIMAL(20,0)) < 9223372036854775807

UPDATE video_status SET play_times = CAST(play_times AS DECIMAL(20,0)) + CAST(#{delta.playDelta} AS DECIMAL(20,0)), like_times = CAST(like_times AS DECIMAL(20,0)) + CAST(#{delta.likeDelta} AS DECIMAL(20,0)), unlike_times = CAST(unlike_times AS DECIMAL(20,0)) + CAST(#{delta.unlikeDelta} AS DECIMAL(20,0)), comment_times = CAST(comment_times AS DECIMAL(20,0)) + CAST(#{delta.commentDelta} AS DECIMAL(20,0)), coin_times = CAST(coin_times AS DECIMAL(20,0)) + CAST(#{delta.coinDelta} AS DECIMAL(20,0)), share_times = CAST(share_times AS DECIMAL(20,0)) + CAST(#{delta.shareDelta} AS DECIMAL(20,0)), collect_times = CAST(collect_times AS DECIMAL(20,0)) + CAST(#{delta.collectDelta} AS DECIMAL(20,0)), danmu_times = CAST(danmu_times AS DECIMAL(20,0)) + CAST(#{delta.danmuDelta} AS DECIMAL(20,0)) WHERE vid = #{vid} AND CAST(play_times AS DECIMAL(20,0)) + CAST(#{delta.playDelta} AS DECIMAL(20,0)) BETWEEN 0 AND 9223372036854775807 AND CAST(like_times AS DECIMAL(20,0)) + CAST(#{delta.likeDelta} AS DECIMAL(20,0)) BETWEEN 0 AND 9223372036854775807 AND CAST(unlike_times AS DECIMAL(20,0)) + CAST(#{delta.unlikeDelta} AS DECIMAL(20,0)) BETWEEN 0 AND 9223372036854775807 AND CAST(comment_times AS DECIMAL(20,0)) + CAST(#{delta.commentDelta} AS DECIMAL(20,0)) BETWEEN 0 AND 9223372036854775807 AND CAST(coin_times AS DECIMAL(20,0)) + CAST(#{delta.coinDelta} AS DECIMAL(20,0)) BETWEEN 0 AND 9223372036854775807 AND CAST(share_times AS DECIMAL(20,0)) + CAST(#{delta.shareDelta} AS DECIMAL(20,0)) BETWEEN 0 AND 9223372036854775807 AND CAST(collect_times AS DECIMAL(20,0)) + CAST(#{delta.collectDelta} AS DECIMAL(20,0)) BETWEEN 0 AND 9223372036854775807 AND CAST(danmu_times AS DECIMAL(20,0)) + CAST(#{delta.danmuDelta} AS DECIMAL(20,0)) BETWEEN 0 AND 9223372036854775807
